canvas_settings.image_style: clean modern high-fidelity web app UI mockup, flat design, sans-serif typography, light theme

layers.description: Solid light grey page backdrop filling the entire square canvas behind everything else.
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: Root background layer; the browser window floats centered on top of it.

layers.description: A desktop browser window with rounded corners and a soft drop shadow, white content area, occupying most of the canvas.
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: Centered above the background; contains the browser chrome strip at its top edge and the web page content below.

layers.description: Browser chrome strip along the window top: three small grey circular window buttons at the left and a wide rounded grey address bar holding the small grey web address "localhost:3000".
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: Owned by the browser window, docked to its top edge, spanning the full window width; the app card sits below it.

layers.description: A centered white application card with a thin light border, rounded corners and a subtle shadow; it holds the whole todo app.
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: Centered horizontally in the browser content area below the chrome; contains the card header, create row and list container stacked top to bottom.

layers.description: Card header band with the app title "My Todos" in large dark sans-serif text aligned to the left with padding.
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: First child inside the app card, directly under its top edge; title aligned to the card left padding.

layers.description: Create row with a single-line text input showing grey placeholder text "Add a new todo…", a blue filled button labeled "Add" immediately to the right of the input, and small grey helper text "Up to 500 characters" under the input.
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: Inside the app card below the header; input and button share one horizontal line, helper text left-aligned under the input.

layers.description: Rounded list container with a hairline border holding four todo rows stacked vertically with thin dividers, oldest at the top.
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: Inside the app card below the create row, spanning the card inner width; owns all four todo rows in creation order.

layers.description: Todo row 1 of 4, first in creation order: a square checkbox at the left filled blue with a white checkmark, done todo text "Buy milk" in faded grey with a horizontal strikethrough, and two small grey text-buttons labeled "Edit" and "Delete" aligned at the right end of the row.
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: First child of the list container; checkbox left-aligned, text left-aligned after the checkbox, action buttons right-aligned; same row layout grid as all other rows.

layers.description: Todo row 2 of 4: a square checkbox at the left filled blue with a white checkmark, done todo text "Pay electricity bill" in faded grey with a horizontal strikethrough, and the same pair of small grey row action text-buttons as the first row aligned at the right end.
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: Second child of the list container directly below the first row; identical layout grid to the first row.

layers.description: Todo row 3 of 4: an empty unchecked square checkbox at the left, not-done todo text "Walk the dog" in normal dark text, and the same pair of small grey row action text-buttons as the first row aligned at the right end.
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: Third child of the list container directly below the second row; identical layout grid to the first row.

layers.description: Todo row 4 of 4, newest at the bottom, a slightly taller row otherwise rendered exactly like the other not-done rows: an empty unchecked square checkbox at the left, not-done todo text "Read 20 pages" in normal dark text, and the same pair of small grey row action text-buttons as the first row aligned at the right end.
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: Fourth child of the list container, last in creation order; same layout grid as the first row with extra blank space reserved under the text for its inline notice.

layers.description: Stale-operation error surface attached to the fourth todo row: small red text reading "Todo does not exist" in the blank space directly under that row's text, marking the failed operation on a todo that is no longer there while the row itself stays rendered unchanged.
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: Owned by the fourth todo row, left-aligned with that row's text, contained within that row's band.
